blocks.text: Yeh chapter 23 (Carbonyl Compounds and Carboxylic Acids) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain, mechanisms qadam ba qadam lafzon mein. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Ketones are prepared by the oxidation of alcohols:
(Ketones kin alcohols ki oxidation se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary alcohols acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se ketones bante hain: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + [O] → CH₃COCH₃ + H₂O. Primary se aldehydes; tertiary oxidise nahi hote; quaternary alcohol hota hi nahi.

blocks.prompt:
II. Which of the following will not give the iodoform test?
(In mein se kaun iodoform test nahi deta?)
blocks.explanation: Iodoform test (I₂ + NaOH → peela CHI₃) woh compounds dete hain jin mein CH₃CO– group ho (ethanal, methyl ketones). Acetaldehyde (CH₃CHO), 2-pentanone (CH₃COCH₂CH₂CH₃) aur acetone (CH₃COCH₃) mein yeh group hai. Option (c) mein CH₃CO– group nahi (chahe 3-pentanone, CH₃CH₂COCH₂CH₃, samjhein ya pentanoic acid), is liye iodoform nahi banta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “3-Pentanoacid” durust naam nahi; shayad 3-pentanone (pentan-3-one, CH₃CH₂COCH₂CH₃) murad hai. Dono soorton mein CH₃CO– group nahi, is liye key (c) theek hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. When a carboxyl acid reacts with an alchol, the product is an:
(Carboxylic acid alcohol se react kare to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Esterification: carboxylic acid ko alcohol aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karne se ester aur pani bante hain: CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein spelling ghalat: “carboxyl acid” ki jagah carboxylic acid aur “alchol” ki jagah alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
IV. Carboxylic acids react with carbonates to produce gas.
(Carboxylic acids carbonates se react kar ke kaun si gas dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: 2CH₃COOH + Na₂CO₃ → 2CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + CO₂ + H₂O (CO₂ ke bulbule).

blocks.prompt:
V. Which type of alcohols produces aldehydes?
(Kis qisam ke alcohols se aldehydes bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Primary alcohols oxidise ho kar aldehydes dete hain (bante hi distil kar liye jaate hain): CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CHO + H₂O. Secondary se ketones bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
VI. The hybridizalion of the oxygen of carbonyl group is:
(Carbonyl group ki oxygen ki hybridization kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbonyl group >C=O mein carbon aur oxygen dono sp² hybridized hain; C=O mein aik σ aur aik π bond hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “hybridizalion” ghalat chhapa hai; sahi lafz hybridization hai.

blocks.prompt:
VII. Which is the main product of the reaction between acetic acid and PCl₅.
(Acetic acid aur PCl₅ ke reaction ka main product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid ka –OH Cl se badal jata hai: CH₃COOH + PCl₅ → CH₃COCl + POCl₃ + HCl. Organic (main) product ethanoyl chloride hai; HCl aur POCl₃ zimni products hain.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Acidic character of chlorine substituted carboxylic acid is higher because chlorine is:
(Chlorine wale carboxylic acid ki acidity zyada kyun hai? Kyun ke chlorine:)

options.text: –I ki wajah se electron kheenchne wala
+I ki wajah se electron dene wala

blocks.explanation: Cl electron kheenchne wala hai (–I effect); yeh carboxylate ion ka negative charge phaila kar use stable karta hai, is liye acid zyada ionise hota hai: ClCH₂COOH pKa 2.86, CH₃COOH 4.74.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) “Electron with drawing” ki jagah electron-withdrawing, aur option (d) “loan pairs” ki jagah lone pairs hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
IX. When formic acid is oxidized, which of the following is formed?
(Formic acid ki oxidation se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methanoic acid mein aldehyde jaisa H–C=O hissa hai aur yeh CO₂ aur H₂O mein oxidise hota hai: HCOOH + [O] → CO₂ + H₂O (maslan Tollens' se: HCOOH + 2[Ag(NH₃)₂]OH → 2Ag + CO₂ + 4NH₃ + 2H₂O).

blocks.prompt:
X. The mechanism by which acyl chlorides react with alcohols is.
(Acyl chlorides alcohols se kis mechanism se react karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohol ki oxygen (nucleophile) pehle δ+ C=O carbon se judti hai (addition), phir Cl⁻ aur H⁺ HCl ban kar nikalte hain aur C=O wapas banta hai (elimination): CH₃COCl + C₂H₅OH → CH₃COOC₂H₅ + HCl. Is liye yeh nucleophilic addition–elimination hai (qadam chapter se aage); majmooi tor par Cl ki jagah OR aata hai.

blocks.text: Q2. Darj zail mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a) How is ethanol converted to acetic acid?
Ethanol ko acetic acid mein kaise badla jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Ethanol ko zyada acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (ya acidified KMnO₄) ke saath reflux karein; pehle banne wala aldehyde aage oxidise ho jata hai:
CH₃CH₂OH + 2[O] → (K₂Cr₂O₇/dil. H₂SO₄, garmi) CH₃COOH + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
b) Give the mechanism for the reductions of ethanal with NaBH₄.
Ethanal ki NaBH₄ se reduction ka mechanism likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Qadam 1: NaBH₄ ka hydride ion H⁻ (nucleophile) CH₃CHO ke δ+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai; C=O ke π electrons oxygen par chale jaate hain aur alkoxide ion CH₃CH₂O⁻ banta hai.
Qadam 2: alkoxide ion pani se H⁺ leta hai: CH₃CH₂O⁻ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH + OH⁻.
Majmooi: CH₃CHO + 2[H] → (NaBH₄) CH₃CH₂OH (ethanol).

blocks.prompt:
c) What is iodofrom reaction?
Iodoform reaction kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Jin compounds mein CH₃CO– group (ethanal, methyl ketones) ya CH₃CH(OH)– (maslan ethanol) ho, woh iodine aur NaOH se tri-iodomethane (iodoform), CHI₃, ka peela precipitate dete hain; is se CH₃CO– group ki pehchan hoti hai.
CH₃CHO + 3I₂ + 4NaOH → CHI₃↓ + HCOONa + 3NaI + 3H₂O

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “iodofrom” ghalat chhapa hai; sahi iodoform hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) Methanoic acid can be oxidized but other carboxylic acids cannot. Why?
Methanoic acid oxidise ho sakta hai magar doosre carboxylic acids nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Methanoic acid, H–COOH, mein carboxyl carbon se H juda hai, is liye is mein aldehyde jaisa H–C=O hissa bhi hai; yeh (kamzor aur taqatwar dono oxidants se) CO₂ + H₂O mein oxidise hota hai aur Tollens' aur Fehling's test deta hai. Doosre acids mein alkyl group juda hai, oxidation ke liye C–C bond torna parta.

blocks.prompt:
e) Explain the influence of chlorine substitution on the acidity of carboxylic acids.
Chlorine substitution ka carboxylic acids ki acidity par kya asar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Cl electron kheenchne wala hai (–I effect); yeh carboxylate ion ka negative charge phaila kar use stable karta hai, is liye acidity barhti hai, aur zyada Cl atoms se acid aur taqatwar:
CH₃COOH (pKa 4.74) < ClCH₂COOH (2.86) < Cl₂CHCOOH (1.26) < Cl₃CCOOH (0.64).

blocks.prompt:
f) Give the reaction of acyl chloride with phenol.
Acyl chloride ka phenol ke saath reaction likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Acyl chloride ko phenol ke saath garam karne se (base phenoxide ion bana kar madad karta hai) phenyl ester aur HCl bante hain:
CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ (phenyl ethanoate) + HCl

blocks.prompt:
g) Explain why carboxylic acid is more acidic than ethanol.
Carboxylic acid ethanol se zyada acidic kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Carboxylate ion (CH₃COO⁻) mein negative charge dono oxygen atoms par phail jata hai, is liye ion stable hai aur H⁺ wapas aasani se nahi leta. Ethoxide ion (C₂H₅O⁻) mein charge aik oxygen par rehta hai aur ethyl group (+I) use aur barhata hai. Is liye RCOOH (pKa ≈ 5) R–OH (pKa ≈ 16) se bohat taqatwar hai.

blocks.prompt:
h) Give reaction of methanal with the Tollen's reagent.
Methanal ka Tollen's reagent ke saath reaction likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Halka garam karne par methanal (aldehyde) Tollens' reagent ke Ag⁺ ko silver metal bana deta hai jo chandi ka aaina (silver mirror) banata hai; methanal khud oxidise hota hai:
HCHO + 2[Ag(NH₃)₂]OH → HCOONH₄ + 2Ag↓ + 3NH₃ + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
i) Write down structural formulae of the following compounds.
i) 2-methylhexanal  ii) 2-methyl-3-pentanone  iii) 3-hydroxypentanl  iv) 4-nitro-2-pentanone  v) 2-chlorobutanol
Darj zail compounds ke structural formulae likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) 2-methylhexanal: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH(CH₃)CHO
ii) 2-methyl-3-pentanone: (CH₃)₂CH–CO–CH₂CH₃
iii) 3-hydroxypentanal: CH₃CH₂CH(OH)CH₂CHO
iv) 4-nitro-2-pentanone: CH₃–CO–CH₂–CH(NO₂)–CH₃
v) 2-chlorobutan-1-ol: CH₃CH₂CHClCH₂OH (agar 2-chlorobutanal murad ho: CH₃CH₂CHClCHO)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “3-hydroxypentanl” ghalat chhapa hai; sahi 3-hydroxypentanal hai. “2-chlorobutanol” mein –OH ka number nahi (2-chlorobutan-1-ol); carbonyl compounds ki list mein shayad 2-chlorobutanal murad tha, is liye dono diye gaye hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Naam se structure banane ka tareeqa: pehle lambi chain likhein (hex = 6, pent = 5, but = 4), phir -al ho to C1 par CHO, -one ho to batayi gayi jagah C=O, phir branches (methyl, chloro, nitro, hydroxy) apne number par lagayein.
Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab likhein)

blocks.prompt:
a) Write down the equation for the reaction of CH₃.CH₂-CHO with LiAlH₄ (dry ether).
CH₃CH₂CHO ka LiAlH₄ (dry ether) ke saath reaction ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Propanal (aldehyde) reduce ho kar primary alcohol, propan-1-ol, banta hai:
CH₃CH₂CHO + 2[H] → (LiAlH₄, dry ether) CH₃CH₂CH₂OH
(H⁻ ion carbonyl carbon se judta hai aur phir alkoxide ko proton milta hai.)

blocks.prompt:
b) An alcohol, C₄H₁₀O undergoes oxidation to form a carboxylic acid, C₄H₈O₂. Give a chemical equation along with conditions.
Alcohol C₄H₁₀O oxidise ho kar carboxylic acid C₄H₈O₂ banata hai. Halaat ke saath equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Sirf primary alcohol carboxylic acid deta hai. Butan-1-ol ko zyada acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (K₂Cr₂O₇/dil. H₂SO₄, garmi) ke saath reflux karne se butanoic acid banta hai; orange rang green ho jata hai:
CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH + 2[O] → CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH + H₂O
(2-methylpropan-1-ol bhi isi tarah 2-methylpropanoic acid, (CH₃)₂CHCOOH, deta hai jo bhi C₄H₈O₂ hai.)

blocks.prompt:
c) Write the structures of all the isomeric alcohols with formula C₄H₁₀O. Give their systematic names. Which one of them forms the above carboxylic acid? Explain why the others do not.
C₄H₁₀O ke tamam isomeric alcohols ke structures aur naam likhein. In mein se kaun upar wala carboxylic acid banata hai, aur baqi kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation:
1. CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH: butan-1-ol (primary)
2. CH₃CH₂CH(OH)CH₃: butan-2-ol (secondary)
3. (CH₃)₂CHCH₂OH: 2-methylpropan-1-ol (primary)
4. (CH₃)₃COH: 2-methylpropan-2-ol (tertiary)
Butan-1-ol butanoic acid, CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH, banata hai (2-methylpropan-1-ol bhi primary hai aur isomer 2-methylpropanoic acid banata hai).
Baqi kyun nahi: butan-2-ol secondary hai, is liye sirf ketone, butanone CH₃COCH₂CH₃ (C₄H₈O), tak oxidise hota hai; in halaat mein ketone aage oxidise nahi hota kyun ke C–C bond torna parta. 2-methylpropan-2-ol tertiary hai: C–OH wale carbon par H nahi, is liye oxidise nahi hota (dichromate orange hi rehta hai).

blocks.prompt:
d) Propanoic acid can be reduced to propan-1-ol by reduction with LiAlH₄. Give a balanced chemical equation. Can we use NaBH₄ for this reaction? If not, give reason.
Propanoic acid LiAlH₄ se propan-1-ol mein reduce hota hai. Balanced equation likhein. Kya NaBH₄ istemal ho sakta hai? Agar nahi to kyun?
blocks.explanation:
CH₃CH₂COOH + 4[H] → (LiAlH₄, dry ether) CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + H₂O
Nahi. NaBH₄ (sodium tetrahydridoborate(III)) narm reducing agent hai; yeh aldehydes aur ketones ko reduce karta hai magar carboxylic acids ko nahi (H₂/Ni bhi nahi). Sirf taqatwar LiAlH₄ (lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III)) –COOH group ko reduce karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. What are aldehydes and ketones? Give the preparation of each.
Aldehydes aur ketones kya hain? Har aik ki tayyari bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Aldehydes aur ketones woh compounds hain jin mein carbonyl group >C=O hota hai.
Aldehyde: carbonyl carbon kam az kam aik H atom se juda hota hai; general formula R–CHO (maslan ethanal, CH₃CHO).
Ketone: carbonyl carbon do alkyl/aryl groups se juda hota hai; general formula R–CO–R′ (maslan propanone, CH₃COCH₃).
Aldehydes ki tayyari: primary alcohols ki acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (ya acidified KMnO₄) se oxidation.
CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → (K₂Cr₂O₇ + H₂SO₄(aq), garmi) CH₃CHO + H₂O
Acidified dichromate qatra qatra garam ethanol mein dala jata hai, aur ethanal bante hi distil kar ke nikal liya jata hai taake aage ethanoic acid na ban jaye. Temperature ethanal ke boiling point se oopar magar ethanol ke boiling point se neeche rakha jata hai, is liye sirf ethanal distil hota hai; khalis ethanal dobara distillation se milta hai. (Apparatus: flask mein ethanol halka garam, dichromate ke liye dropping funnel, condenser aur ethanal jama karne ke liye barf mein rakha receiver.)
Ketones ki tayyari: secondary alcohols ki isi tarah oxidation.
CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ (propan-2-ol) + [O] → (K₂Cr₂O₇ + H₂SO₄, garmi) CH₃COCH₃ (propanone) + H₂O
In halaat mein ketone carboxylic acid nahi banta, is liye use foran distil karne ki zaroorat nahi. Dono mein orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ green (Cr³⁺) ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Give four methods for the preparation of carboxylic acids.
Carboxylic acids banane ke chaar tareeqe likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Primary alcohols aur aldehydes ki oxidation: zyada acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ya KMnO₄ ke saath reflux.
CH₃CH₂OH + 2[O] → (K₂Cr₂O₇/dil. H₂SO₄, garmi) CH₃COOH + H₂O
CH₃CHO + [O] → CH₃COOH
2. Alkane nitriles ki hydrolysis: acid mein seedha acid; alkali mein salt banta hai jo acidify karne par acid deta hai.
CH₃CN + 2H₂O + HCl → CH₃COOH + NH₄Cl
CH₃CN + H₂O + NaOH → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + NH₃; CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + HCl → CH₃COOH + NaCl
3. Esters ki hydrolysis: dilute acid ya dilute alkali ke saath reflux.
CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O ⇌ (H₃O⁺) CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH
CH₃COOC₂H₅ + NaOH → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + C₂H₅OH, phir HCl se acidify.
4. Methylbenzene ki acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidation, benzoic acid (benzenecarboxylic acid):
C₆H₅CH₃ + 3[O] → (KMnO₄, dil. H₂SO₄, garmi) C₆H₅COOH + H₂O

blocks.prompt:
Q6. How does ethanoic acid reacts with:
I) NaOH  ii) ethanol  iii) SOCl  iv) PCl₅
Ethanoic acid in ke saath kaise react karta hai: NaOH, ethanol, SOCl₂, PCl₅?
blocks.explanation:
I) NaOH: acid–base (neutralisation) reaction; tezabi H badal jata hai aur sodium ethanoate aur pani bante hain.
CH₃COOH + NaOH → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺ + H₂O
ii) Ethanol: conc. H₂SO₄ ke saath garam karne par esterification (reversible) se ethyl ethanoate, meethi khushboo wala ester, banta hai.
CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ (conc. H₂SO₄) CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O
Acid ka C–OH bond aur alcohol ka O–H bond toot-te hain.
iii) SOCl₂ (thionyl chloride): –OH ki jagah Cl aa kar ethanoyl chloride banta hai; zimni products gases hain.
CH₃COOH + SOCl₂ → CH₃COCl + HCl + SO₂
iv) PCl₅: –OH ki jagah Cl aata hai.
CH₃COOH + PCl₅ → CH₃COCl + POCl₃ + HCl

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa iii) mein “SOCl” chhapa hai; thionyl chloride SOCl₂ hai (subscript 2 ghayab hai).

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Give the mechanisms of the reactions of carbonyl compounds with:
i) HCN  b) NaBH₄
Carbonyl compounds ke HCN aur NaBH₄ ke saath reactions ke mechanisms likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono nucleophilic addition reactions hain: nucleophile δ+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai (C=O polar hai, O par δ−), π bond toot-ta hai, aur phir oxygen H⁺ leti hai.
i) HCN (cyanohydrin yani hydroxynitrile banta hai):
HCN bohat zehreeli hai, is liye mixture mein hi banayi jati hai: zyada KCN aur carbonyl compound mein HCl dala jata hai: KCN (zyada) + HCl (kam) → HCN + KCl. HCN ke carbon par lone pair nahi aur yeh bohat kam ionise hoti hai, is liye KCN ki thodi zyada miqdar azad CN⁻ ions deti hai jo reaction shuru karte aur tez karte (catalyse) hain.
Qadam 1: cyanide ion :C≡N⁻ RHC=O ke δ+ carbon par hamla karta hai; π electrons oxygen par chale jaate hain aur anion R–CH(O⁻)–CN banta hai. (reversible)
Qadam 2: anion HCN se H⁺ le kar hydroxynitrile R–CH(OH)–CN banata hai aur CN⁻ wapas ban jata hai. (reversible)
Equilibria door daayen taraf hain. Maslan CH₃CHO + HCN → (KCN/HCl) CH₃CH(OH)CN (2-hydroxypropanenitrile); propanone se (CH₃)₂C(OH)CN.
b) NaBH₄ (alcohol tak reduction):
Qadam 1: NaBH₄ ka hydride ion H⁻ (nucleophile) δ+ carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai; C=O ke π electrons oxygen par jaate hain aur alkoxide ion banta hai, maslan RCHO → R–CH₂–O⁻.
Qadam 2: alkoxide ion pani se H⁺ leta hai: R–CH₂–O⁻ + H₂O → R–CH₂–OH + OH⁻.
Aldehydes se primary alcohols (CH₃CHO + 2[H] → CH₃CH₂OH) aur ketones se secondary alcohols (CH₃COCH₃ + 2[H] → CH₃CH(OH)CH₃). Equations mein [H] NaBH₄ se aane wali hydrogen hai, atomic hydrogen nahi.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Nucleophile hamesha δ+ carbon par hamla karta hai aur π electrons ka joda oxygen par chala jata hai; phir oxygen proton (H⁺) le leti hai. HCN aur NaBH₄ dono mein yahi do qadam hain, sirf nucleophile mukhtalif hai (CN⁻ ya H⁻).

blocks.prompt:
Q8. Explain the relative acidities of chlorine substituted carboxylic acids.
Chlorine wale carboxylic acids ki nisbati acidity ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Carboxylic acid ionise ho kar carboxylate ion banata hai: CH₃COOH ⇌ CH₃COO⁻ + H⁺. Acid ki taqat us ke conjugate base ki stability par munhasir hai; Ka zyada (pKa kam) to acid zyada taqatwar (pKa = −log Ka).
Carboxylate ion mein negative charge pehle hi dono oxygen atoms par phaila hota hai. Electron dene wala group (+I) is charge ko barha kar ion ko unstable karta hai (acidity kam), jab ke electron kheenchne wala group (−I) charge ko phaila kar ion ko stable karta hai (acidity zyada).
Chlorine bohat electronegative hai aur C–C bond ke zariye electrons kheenchti hai (−I effect). Ethanoic acid ke CH₃ group ke H atoms ko Cl se badalne par carboxylate ion stable hota hai, aur har naya Cl asar barhata hai:
CH₃COOH, pKa 4.74
ClCH₂COOH (chloroethanoic acid), pKa 2.86
Cl₂CHCOOH (dichloroethanoic acid), pKa 1.26
Cl₃CCOOH (trichloroethanoic acid), pKa 0.64, kuch mineral acids jitna taqatwar.
Acidity ki tarteeb: Cl₃CCOOH > Cl₂CHCOOH > ClCH₂COOH > CH₃COOH.
(Isi tarah methanoic acid, jis mein +I alkyl group nahi, pKa 3.75, ethanoic acid se taqreeban 10 guna taqatwar hai.)

blocks.prompt:
Q9. Explain the relative ease of hydrolysis of acyl chlorides, alkyl chlorides and halogenoarenes.
Acyl chlorides, alkyl chlorides aur halogenoarenes ki hydrolysis ki nisbati aasani ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Reactivity ka muqabla pani se hydrolysis ke zariye kiya jata hai (pani nucleophile ban kar Cl wale carbon par hamla karta hai), ethanoyl chloride, chloroethane aur chlorobenzene se.
CH₃COCl + H₂O → CH₃COOH + HCl (room temperature, foran)
CH₃CH₂Cl + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH + HCl (reflux par garmi; aahista)
C₆H₅Cl + H₂O → koi reaction nahi
Acyl chloride: carbonyl carbon do bohat electronegative atoms, O aur Cl, se juda hai jin ka taqatwar electron kheenchne ka asar is par bara δ+ charge paida karta hai. Pani itni tezi se hamla karta hai ke reaction chand minute mein mukammal ho jata hai.
Alkyl chloride: carbon sirf aik electronegative atom (Cl) se juda hai, is liye δ+ charge kam hai. Pani ka hamla aahista hai; 100 °C par bhi reaction ko taqreeban 14 din lagte hain.
Halogenoarene: C–Cl wala carbon benzene ring ka hissa hai. Cl ka lone pair ring ke π electrons ke saath phail jata hai, jis se C–Cl bond mein partial double-bond character aa jata hai; bond itna mazboot hai ke nahi toot-ta, is liye hydrolysis nahi hoti.
Hydrolysis ki aasani ki tarteeb: acyl chloride > alkyl chloride > aryl chloride.

rows: C=O carbon, O aur Cl dono se juda
sp³ carbon, sirf Cl se juda
Reflux par garmi (100 °C par taqreeban 14 din)
